caption: Is Jesus the faithful priest promised after Eli’s family failed? Hebrews creates a plausible larger pattern, but Samuel’s story points historically to Zadok.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Is Jesus Samuel’s faithful priest? God promises a faithful priest after condemning Eli’s corrupt family. Hebrews later calls Jesus a faithful high priest.
slides.body: God promises a faithful priest after condemning Eli’s corrupt family. Hebrews later calls Jesus a faithful high priest.
slides.heading: Is Jesus Samuel’s faithful priest?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of 1Sam 2:35: I will raise up for Myself a faithful priest.
slides.body: I will raise up for Myself a faithful priest.
slides.heading: 1Sam 2:35

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Heb 2:17, BSB: He became a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.
slides.body: He became a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.
slides.heading: Claimed fulfilment · Heb 2:17

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: The resemblance is striking Jesus is faithful, serves as high priest and has a permanent priesthood. Christians can see a larger pattern here.
slides.body: Jesus is faithful, serves as high priest and has a permanent priesthood. Christians can see a larger pattern here.
slides.heading: The resemblance is striking

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: But the story has its own outcome Kings says Eli’s line was removed and Zadok became priest. Hebrews does not explicitly cite this promise.
slides.body: Kings says Eli’s line was removed and Zadok became priest. Hebrews does not explicitly cite this promise.
slides.heading: But the story has its own outcome

title: The faithful priest
